thig13.1:1.1: samatto. || kāḷakā bhamaravaṇṇasadisā vellitaggā mama muddhajā ahuṃ | te jarāya sāṇavākasadisā saccavādivacanaṃ anaññathā. || ||
thig13.1:2.1: vāsito va surabhikaraṇḍako pupphapūraṃ mama uttamaṅgabhu | taṃ jarāya sasalomagandhikaṃ saccavādivacanaṃ anaññathā. || ||
thig13.1:3.1: kānanaṃ va sahitaṃ suropitaṃ kocchasūcivicitaggasobhitaṃ | taṃ jarāya viraḷaṃ tahiṃ tahiṃ saccavādivacanaṃ anaññathā. || ||
thig13.1:4.1: saṇhagandhakasuvaṇṇamaṇḍitaṃ sobhate su veṇihi alaṅkataṃ | taṃ jarāya khalati siraṃ kataṃ saccavādivacanaṃ anaññathā. || ||
thig13.1:5.1: cittakārasukatā va lekhitā sobhate su bhamukā pure mama | tā jarāya valihi palambitā saccavādivacanaṃ anaññathā. || ||
thig13.1:6.1: bhassarā surucirā yathā maṇi nettāhesuṃ abhinīla-m-āyatā | te jarāy' abhihatā na sobhate saccavādivacanaṃ anaññathā. || ||
thig13.1:7.1: saṇhatuṅgasadisī ca nāsikā sobhate su abhiyobbanaṃ paṭi | sā jarāya upakūlitā viya saccavādivacanaṃ anaññathā. || ||
thig13.1:8.1: kaṅkaṇaṃ va sukataṃ suniṭṭhitaṃ sobhate su mama kaṇṇapāḷiyo pure | tā jarāya valihi palambitā saccavādivacanaṃ anaññathā. || ||
thig13.1:9.1: pattalimakulavaṇṇasadisā sobhate su dantā pure mama | te jarāya khaṇḍā yavapītakā saccavādivacanaṃ anaññathā. || ||
thig13.1:10.1: kānanasmiṃ vanasaṇḍacāriṇī kokilā va madhuraṃ nikūjitaṃ | taṃ jarāya khalitaṃ tahiṃ tahiṃ saccavādivacanaṃ anaññathā. || ||
thig13.1:11.1: saṇhakampurī va suppamajjitā sobhate su gīvā pure mama | sā jarāya bhaggā vināsitā saccavādivacanaṃ anaññathā. || ||
thig13.1:12.1: vaṭṭapalighasadisopamā ubho sobhate su bāhā pure mama | tā jarāya yathā pāṭalī dubbalikā saccavādivacanaṃ anaññathā. || ||
thig13.1:13.1: saṇhamuddikāsuvaṇṇamaṇḍitā sobhate su hatthā pure mama | te jarāya yathā mūlamūlikā saccavādivacanaṃ anaññathā. || ||
thig13.1:14.1: pīnavaṭṭapahituggatā ubho sobhate su thanakā pure mama | te rindī va lambante 'nodakā saccavādivacanaṃ anaññathā. || ||
thig13.1:15.1: kañcanassa phalakaṃ va sumaṭṭhaṃ sobhate su kāyo pure mama | so valini sukhumāhi otato saccavādivacanaṃ anaññathā. || ||
thig13.1:16.1: nāgabhogasadisopamā ubho sobhate su ūrū pure mama | te jarāya yathā veḷunāḷiyo saccavādivacanaṃ anaññathā. || ||
thig13.1:17.1: saṇhanūpurasuvaṇṇamaṇḍitā sobhate su jaṅghā pure mama | tā jarāya tiladaṇḍakā-r-iva saccavādivacanaṃ anaññathā. || ||
thig13.1:18.1: tūlapuṇṇasadisopamā ubho sobhate su pādā pure mama | te jarāya phuṭikā valīmatā saccavādivacanaṃ anaññathā. || ||
thig13.1:19.1: ediso ahu ayaṃ samussayo jajjaro bahudukkhānam ālayo | so 'palepapatito jarāgharo saccavādivacanaṃ anaññathā. || ||
